::: {#rem-definitions-iff}
#### A definition's "if" means "if and only if"

@def-even-odd says that $n$ is even "if" $n = 2k$ for some integer $k$,
but it means "if and only if" (@def-iff):
an integer is even exactly when it can be written as $2k$.
So a proof can use a definition in both directions:
to show that $n$ is even, write $n$ as $2k$;
and from "$n$ is even", conclude that $n = 2k$ for some integer $k$.

:::
